recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a male musician in denim attire, standing with an acoustic guitar against a dark, atmospheric background with dramatic top-down lighting and a gritty, metallic typographic overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with guitar acting as a grounding anchor
High-contrast lighting creating a spotlight effect on the head and shoulders
Large-scale typography layered between the subject's legs and torso
Textured metallic finish on text echoing the worn denim and guitar wood
coreInvariants: Acoustic guitar positioned centrally between feet

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar body at the bottom center, providing a dark, solid base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the illuminated face/cap, follows the denim jacket down to the hands, then to the large central text, and finally to the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the left and right flanks create a narrow vertical corridor of light.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and charcoal (denim and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and sepia (guitar wood and light flares)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the spotlight and the deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and desaturated blues

characterSpecificRedesigns: Textured 'distressed metal' fill applied to all glyphs
Subtle drop shadow to separate text from the busy denim background

composition.position: Mid-lower third, spanning the width of the subject
composition.overlap: Placed behind the guitar neck but in front of the legs

treatment.fill: Silver-grey with concrete or brushed metal texture

typesetting.alignment: Left-aligned to the start of the display text

composition.position: Directly above the first letter of the display text
composition.scale: Small, roughly 1/5th the size of display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and weight contrast within the same sans-serif family.

preserve: Heavy weight of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary visual weight and geometric stability.
Good for the subtitle text due to its clean, condensed nature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body shot of a man in a denim jacket and jeans, wearing a black baseball cap, looking down. He is holding an acoustic guitar vertically in front of him. The lighting is a dramatic top-down spotlight in a dark studio with a reflective floor and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, uppercase sans-serif text across the middle, using a distressed metallic texture. Place a smaller, thin, wide-tracked subtitle directly above the start of the main text.

verificationChecks: Is the text layered between the subject and the background?
Does the lighting create a clear vertical axis?
Is the texture on the text consistent with the gritty mood?
Is the guitar centered and grounded?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress/grain on the typography
Color of the denim (light wash vs dark wash)
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Unique facial features of the specific artist

mustAchieve: Tactile quality in the denim and text textures
avoid: Thin, delicate typography for the main name

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the face.
Ensure the guitar looks naturally held.
Verify the metallic texture doesn't make the text unreadable.
Confirm the vignette doesn't clip the subject's feet.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central pensive figure + denim wardrobe + vertical spotlight + heavy textured sans-serif mid-frame.
